privacyUrl.title: Privacy policy link
privacyUrl.description: An https address or a path on your website (for example /privacy). Every word of the banner is in Texts.

askAgainMonths.title: Ask again after (months)
askAgainMonths.description: How long a visitor's choice holds before the banner asks again, 1 to 24 months (with the banner off, a choice from your own consent tool holds 12 months). Check what the law where you operate allows: many privacy authorities expect at most 12 or 13 months.
